title: Let the Voice of Destiny Ring Out!

text_block_list.text:
As if guided by some irresistible force, I agreed to be her Trainer.
...Yes, I gave a definitive answer.
choice_data_list: (No, no, I can't just let momentum carry me away!)
(No, no, I can't just let momentum carry me away!)

text_block_list.text:
Her abilities, goals, dreams... There is so much I need to know before taking
charge of her precious athletic career. Either way, we need to have a proper talk.
choice_data_list: (Signing the official contract comes after that.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer's Room at lunch, right?!
Got it, I'll bring my bento over!
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll be waiting.

text_block_list.text: And so, lunchtime arrives—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I feel destiny in you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, it's true, it's total destiny!
Let's forge the future together. I swear—I'll make you happy!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh... ♡
...U-Um... then yes, ...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! I'll definitely awaken the 'Voice of Destiny' inside you too!
Keep your eyes on me! ...See ya later!
choice_data_list: Hold on...!
Hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Sorry, did I make you come look for me?
Thanks though!
choice_data_list: (She clearly doesn't mean any harm...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I see! You wanna know more about me.
Go right ahead, ask me anything! The 'Voice of Destiny' agrees!
choice_data_list: Before that, what is this Voice of Destiny...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh yeah, that's right.
No one else can hear it right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The Voice of Destiny is this incredible voice that gives me
a huge push forward whenever I make a choice!
choice_data_list: ............Could you explain a bit more?
............Could you explain a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? People always say that to me, but it's hard to put into words!
Anyway, whatever the Voice of Destiny approves of always turns out great!

...In short, Epiphaneia deeply treasures this Voice of Destiny only she can hear,
and it apparently plays a huge role in all her decisions.
choice_data_list: So choosing me as your Trainer was also...?
So choosing me as your Trainer was also...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yep! The Voice of Destiny gave me the green light!
It said if I feel like you're the one, then it's absolutely the right call!
choice_data_list: (S-She decided something that huge just like that...?)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So, what else?
Feel free to ask whatever you want!
choice_data_list: In that case... could you tell me your dream?
In that case... could you tell me your dream?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: To grant the Voice of Destiny to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I run and keep on winning, everyone will get to know me.
They'll watch me and feel that destiny. When that happens—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The "Voice" inside everyone will awaken and push them forward too!
—Just like me! How about that? Isn't it awesome?!
choice_data_list: I-I suppose...?
I-I suppose...?

text_block_list.text:
It might not be a conventional dream like winning the Nihon Derby
or proving herself, but in her own way, she truly has one.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You understand me pretty well now, right?
Next, I'll show you what I'm made of! Let's start training tomorrow!
choice_data_list: ...! Yeah, let's do it!
...! Yeah, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then after school tomorrow!
Figure out what we're doing beforehand, okay? I can't wait!

After school the next day. I enthusiastically prepared a training menu
and waited at the agreed meeting spot, but...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm, hmm-hmm-hmm♪
choice_data_list: Epi... you seem to be having fun.
Epi... you seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I was just looking for you!
Here, this is guaranteed to be delicious—it's the 'Legendary Yakisoba Pan'!
choice_data_list: The legendary yakisoba pan?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This is it, right here! It's been the talk of the school store.
They say occasionally, a super premium one gets mixed in with the regular ones!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And just as I started getting hungry, I heard the Voice of Destiny!
I grabbed one at random, and it had the "Legendary" sticker on it! ♪
choice_data_list: That was pretty lucky. By the way—
That was pretty lucky. By the way—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa? 
Ooh! Ooooh~~?!
choice_data_list: Aaaah...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Don't be shy, take it!
The Voice of Destiny says you should have it too, Kris S!
choice_data_list: (Wait, is that... Symboli Kris S?!)

text_block_list.text:
She's a powerhouse of the highest caliber, having won back-to-back victories in both
the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen, and the prestigious Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Epi. Who is that Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer!
...Ah, don't worry. I've still got more legendary pan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...I see.
Take good care of Epi.
choice_data_list: Um... what's the connection between you two?
Um... what's the connection between you two?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Kris S is my master!
choice_data_list: Wait, but isn't Cesario also...?
Wait, but isn't Cesario also...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It means I've got two masters: Cesario and Kris S!
Besides, the Voice of Destiny told me these two are the ones!
choice_data_list: I see... that was the voice, too...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kris S, you're training after this, right?
Me too! Let's do it together! You don't mind, right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: (Oh, so she did remember...)
(Oh, so she did remember...)

text_block_list.text:
It was completely, utterly different from our original plan... but at
Epiphaneia's insistence, we ended up holding a joint training session with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: (Incredible... she's lifting that much weight...?!)

text_block_list.text:
Watching her, Epiphaneia was already performing well above average in every metric.
Among them—her sheer power, in particular, was truly eye-opening.

Rather than pure muscle strength, it was more like a terrifying explosive burst
that unleashed whenever her power found its direction. I had felt the same thing when watching her run.
choice_data_list: (If we can harness that properly, it'll be a lethal weapon.)
(If we can harness that properly, it'll be a lethal weapon.)

text_block_list.text:
Next, I had her run a 200m all-out sprint. Blasting through at a pace
that would easily gas out any normal pre-debut trainee—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~...!
—How's that, Trainer?! Pretty amazing, right?!
choice_data_list: (Whoa, her breathing isn't even ragged!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Doryaaaahhhhhh!!!!

She stormed up the steep slope of the uphill course with effortless, powerful strides.
Epiphaneia's raw talent was—undeniably magnificent.
choice_data_list: (Even so...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: (As expected, she makes it look easy.)
(As expected, she makes it look easy.)

text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia was remarkable. But Symboli Kris S, who cleared a regimen several times
more grueling without breaking a sweat, was on an entirely different level.
choice_data_list: (Reaching that realm is going to take a lot of work.)
(Reaching that realm is going to take a lot of work.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! You saw how awesome I am, right?!
Let's wrap it up for today! See you after school tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Good work! 
Kris S, let's go eat together!
choice_data_list: (...Looks like I'll have to start tomorrow by tracking her down again...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer!
I'm all done warming up!
choice_data_list: (Wait, what?! She's actually here...!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'm changing the menu, but that's fine with you, right?
—A match race with Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Kris S, I'm... definitely not gonna lose!
Allllllright, let's do this!
choice_data_list: Wait, wait, wait! Hold on a second!
Wait, wait, wait! Hold on a second!

text_block_list.text:
The gap between Symboli Kris S and Epiphaneia right now was just too vast.
To put it bluntly, she had virtually zero chance of winning.
choice_data_list: Um, you have some kind of goal in mind for this, right?
Um, you have some kind of goal in mind for this, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Nope! But the Voice of Destiny told me to go for it!
Which means, I'm gonna win!
choice_data_list: No, no, that voice has got to be mistaken—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, it is definitely not mistaken!
choice_data_list: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I believe I can win, and the Voice of Destiny is pushing me forward.
So, I will definitely win. Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I am strong. I am right!
The Voice of Destiny says so, too. That's why—I will win!

—An overwhelming surge of confidence. Even though I knew
it was completely unfounded... I found myself completely captivated.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooaaaaahhhhh!!!!
—Yeah, that's it! I'm gonna win, win... WIN WIN WIIIIIIIN!
choice_data_list: (There it is, that explosive power...!)

text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia tore across the track with unbelievable speed. The sheer momentum
was so breathtaking—my heart leapt. Could it be... maybe she really—!
